about_the_game:
In a distant realm of heaven, an epic, long-running story unfolds, of which this game (visual interactive novel) is the first chapter. Our protagonist, Yan Zilong, renowned as a fearsome warrior, finds his life dramatically altered by an unexpected encounter. Awakening in a luxurious hotel room in Jiang City, he discovers beside him Xia Yatong, not only a striking beauty but also the president of the powerful Xia Corporation and surprisingly, one of Yan Zilong's unknown fiancées.

Set against the backdrop of a parallel universe that blends contemporary urban settings with the mystical world of cultivation, this story reveals a cosmos where besides ordinary humans, there exist practitioners, divine beasts, and various supernatural forces. Yan Zilong, raised by three mentors since childhood, has honed unparalleled skills, including possession of a rare "Kirin Kidney," which endows him with extraordinary physical prowess and abilities. However, the young hero's life is far from smooth sailing; as the plot thickens, he faces a series of complex decisions and challenges.

The visual interactive novel "My Kirin kidney and my beloved teachers" captivates readers through exquisite illustrations, vivid textual descriptions, and richly designed options, allowing them to immerse themselves fully into this fantastical narrative. Players assume the role of Yan Zilong, making choices at pivotal moments that influence the storyline's direction while uncovering secrets about the protagonist's past. From their first meeting in the hotel room, confronting an impending marriage, to unraveling hidden plots behind the scenes, every decision carries significant weight.

Furthermore, this work introduces a multi-threaded narrative structure, offering multiple endings for players to explore. Whichever path chosen will lead readers into new chapters of adventure, experiencing unprecedented emotional fluctuations and thrilling tension.
